script.title: PICKUP AT THE PHARMACY
script.story_hook: An older man picks up his blood pressure medicine.
script.intro_zh: 一位年長男士到藥局領取血壓藥,忘帶證件也能領。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today at the pharmacy counter.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎!今天來到藥局櫃台前聽力練習。
script.outro: Sixty lines down — pharmacy visits feel simple now.
script.outro_zh: 六十句聽完了,上藥局領藥現在變得很簡單。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's practice — repeat after every line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 來練習吧,每句都跟著唸一次。
script.char_a_description: an elderly man in his late sixties with thin white hair and a gray mustache, wearing a navy knit cardigan, brown trousers and dark leather loafers, short and sturdy build
script.char_b_description: a young woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length straight brown hair tied back, wearing a white lab coat over a teal blouse, black slacks and flat shoes, average build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm here to pick up a prescription.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm hɪr tə pɪk ʌp ə prɪˈskrɪpʃən/
dialogue.zh: 你好,我來領處方藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good morning — may I see your ID?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ me aɪ si jɔr ˌaɪˈdiː/
dialogue.zh: 早安,請出示身分證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no… I left my ID at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ noʊ aɪ lɛft maɪ ˌaɪˈdi æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 糟了,我把身分證忘在家裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries — your phone number works.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwəriz jɔr foʊn ˈnʌmbər wərks/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係,報電話號碼也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's five-five-five, two-one-oh-eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts faɪv faɪv faɪv tuː wʌn oʊ eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是五五五、二一零八。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you… yes, it's ready. One moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju jɛs ɪts ˈrɛdi wʌn ˈmoʊmənt/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝……找到了,請稍等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. It's for my blood pressure, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ɪts fər maɪ blʌd ˈprɛʃər raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好,這是我的高血壓藥,對吧?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — lisinopril, ten milligrams.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs lɪˈsɪnəprɪl tɛn ˈmɪləɡrəmz/
dialogue.zh: 是的,是十毫克的降壓藥 lisinopril。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many pills do I take a day?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni pɪlz du aɪ teɪk ə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 一天要吃幾顆?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One pill every morning, with food.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn pɪl ˈɛvri ˈmɔrnɪŋ wɪð fud/
dialogue.zh: 每天早上吃一顆,搭配食物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With food? Can't I take it on an empty stomach?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð fud kænt aɪ teɪk ɪt ɑn əˈempti ˈstʌmək/
dialogue.zh: 配食物?不可以空腹吃嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can, but food stops an upset stomach.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn bʌt fud stɑps æn ʌpˈsɛt ˈstʌmək/
dialogue.zh: 可以,但吃飯能避免胃部不適。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know. What if I miss a dose?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ wʌt ɪf aɪ mɪs ə doʊs/
dialogue.zh: 記下了,萬一漏吃怎麼辦?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it as soon as you remember.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt əz sun æz ju ˌrɪˈmɛmbər/
dialogue.zh: 想起來就趕快補吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if it's almost time for the next?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ɪts ˈɔlmoʊst taɪm fər ðə nɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 那快到下一劑的時間呢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then skip it — never double up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn skɪp ɪt ˈnɛvər ˈdʌbəl ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 就跳過,千萬別一次吃兩顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. How many refills are left?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt haʊ ˈmɛni ˈriˌfɪlz ɑr lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 了解,還剩幾次補領?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two left, then the doctor renews it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː lɛft ðɛn ðə ˈdɑktər rɪˈnuːz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 剩兩次,之後要請醫生開新單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Um, last month this cost more, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʌm læst mʌnθ ðɪs kɔst mɔr aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 好。呃,上個月這個好像比較貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check… yes, the copay changed.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk jɛs ðə ˈkoʊˌpeɪ tʃeɪndʒd/
dialogue.zh: 我查一下……沒錯,自付額變了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Changed? So now it costs less?
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃeɪndʒd soʊ naʊ ɪt kɔsts lɛs/
dialogue.zh: 變了?所以現在比較便宜?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little — it's twelve dollars today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl ɪts twɛlv ˈdɑlərz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 一點點,今天十二塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fair. Should I show my insurance card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts fɛr ʃʊd aɪ ʃoʊ maɪ ɪnˈʃʊrəns kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 很公道。要出示保險卡嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's on file already — you're all set.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɑn faɪl ɔlˈrɛdi jʊrz ɔl sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 已經存檔了,沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Does this pill make you dizzy?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpərfɪkt dʌz ðɪs pɪl meɪk ju ˈdɪzi/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。這藥會讓人頭暈嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rarely — some people feel tired at first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪrli səm ˈpipəl fil ˈtaɪərd æt fərst/
dialogue.zh: 少見,剛開始有人會覺得累。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tired? Should I take it at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪərd ʃʊd aɪ teɪk ɪt æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 會累?那我晚上吃可以嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep mornings for now; watch how you feel.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ˈmɔrnɪŋz fər naʊ wɑtʃ haʊ ju fil/
dialogue.zh: 先維持早上吃,觀察自己的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Can I drink coffee with it?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ kæn aɪ drɪŋk ˈkɔfi wɪð ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好,可以配咖啡一起吃嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coffee's fine — just skip extra salt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfiz faɪn dʒʌst skɪp ˈɛkstrə sɔlt/
dialogue.zh: 咖啡沒問題,飲食只要少鹽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Skip salt? Does the pill have salt?
dialogue.phonetic: /skɪp sɔlt dʌz ðə pɪl hæv sɔlt/
dialogue.zh: 少鹽?這藥裡有鹽分嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No — but salty food fights the medicine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bʌt ˈsɔlti fud faɪts ðə ˈmɛdəsən/
dialogue.zh: 沒有,但吃太鹹會抵消藥效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood. Where should I keep the bottle?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndərˈstʊd wɛr ʃʊd aɪ kip ðə ˈbɑtəl/
dialogue.zh: 懂了,藥瓶該收在哪裡?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A cool, dry place — not the bathroom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kuːl draɪ pleɪs nɑt ðə ˈbæθˌrʊm/
dialogue.zh: 陰涼乾燥的地方,別放浴室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, shower steam ruins pills.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ˈʃaʊər stim ˈruːɪnz pɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 對,洗澡的蒸氣會讓藥受潮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. Now — one small problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli naʊ wʌn smɔl ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 對,不過現在有個小問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh? What's wrong with my order?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ wʌts rɔŋ wɪð maɪ ˈɔrdər/
dialogue.zh: 噢?我的藥有什麼問題?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We packed a different shape today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi pækt ə ˈdɪfərənt ʃeɪp təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天給您的是另一種形狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Different? Is it still the same medicine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɪfərənt ɪz ɪt stɪl ðə seɪm ˈmɛdəsən/
dialogue.zh: 不一樣?還是同一種藥嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — new supplier, same dose and effect.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs nuː səˈplɑɪər seɪm doʊs ænd ɪˈfɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 是的,換了廠商,劑量效果都一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That worries me a little, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈwəriz mi ə ˈlɪtəl ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說,我有點擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair — ask your doctor anytime.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr æsk jɔr ˈdɑktər ˈɛniˌtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 應該的,隨時可以詢問醫師。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Um, my wife takes a similar pill.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ʌm maɪ waɪf teɪks ə ˈsɪmələ pɪl/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。呃,我太太也吃相似的藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please never share prescriptions.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz ˈnɛvər ʃɛr ˌpriːskrɪpˈʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 請千萬別共用處方藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course. When should I come back?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs wɛn ʃʊd aɪ kʌm bæk/
dialogue.zh: 當然。我下次該何時來?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In twenty-eight days, or when it's low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ˈtwɛnti eɪt deɪz ɔr wɛn ɪts loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 二十八天後,或藥剩一點時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I call in a refill early?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ kɔl ɪn ə ˈriˌfɪl ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 可以提早打電話補領嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and we text when refills are ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd wi tɛkst wɛn ˈriˌfɪlz ɑr ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 可以,能領時我們會發簡訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great — a text beats a paper slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ə tɛkst biːtəz ə ˈpeɪpər slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 太好了,簡訊比紙條方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Same here. That'll be twelve dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ seɪm hɪr ðæts bi twɛlv ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 哈,我也是。共十二塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's my card. Do I sign anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz maɪ kɑrd du aɪ saɪn ˈɛniˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的卡,要簽名嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just here… and there. All done!
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst hɪr ænd ðɛr ɔl dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 簽這裡……還有這裡,完成了!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you so much for explaining.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ fər ɪkˈspleɪnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 非常感謝您說明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure — take care, and eat breakfast!
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈplɛʒər teɪk kɛr ænd it ˈbrɛkfəst/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣,保重,記得吃早餐!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Have a good weekend.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl hæv ə ɡʊd ˈwikˌɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 我會的,週末愉快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too. Here's your bag, sir.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tuː hɪrz jɔr bæɡ sər/
dialogue.zh: 您也是,給您藥袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great — see you next month, then!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt si ju nɛkst mʌnθ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 好,那我們下個月見!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take care! Bring the bottle next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk kɛr brɪŋ ðə ˈbɑtəl nɛkst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 保重!下次記得帶舊藥瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. Thanks for your patience.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl duː θæŋks fər jɔr ˈpeɪʃəns/
dialogue.zh: 知道了,謝謝您的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's our job — get well soon!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɑr dʒɑb ɡɛt wɛl sun/
dialogue.zh: 這是我們的工作,身體健康!

"Never double up!" — the safety rule you will actually hear at a pharmacy counter. In this 60-line A2 listening animation, an older man picks up his blood pressure medicine without his photo ID, learns the dose and why food matters, asks about refills and a changed copay, handles a surprise about a new pill shape, and pays twelve dollars at the register. Listen line by line, then repeat every sentence out loud in the shadowing chapter. Practical, polite, and full of real pharmacy phrases you can reuse. No memorizing — just listen often.
